name: Research Bot
description: Answers questions by going out and finding material, then attaching the sources so the reasoning can be checked; anything it could not verify is flagged as such rather than quietly folded in. Best when the cost of a confident wrong answer is high and you intend to read the citations.

official.title: Research Bot by Arthur
official.description:
This bot exists to do deep research and provide verifiable answers with sources.

It never returns an answer with an unverified source without tagging...
